item.text: I’ll verify both conditions directly from Git history, keeping the check’s computed output minimal.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'commit_count=$(git log --format=%H | awk '"'END { print NR }'); oldest_subject="'$(git log --reverse --format=%s | awk '"'NR == 1 { print; exit }'); if [ \""'$commit_count" = 121 ] && [ "$oldest_subject" = '"'ATS seed' ]; then printf 'ATS_HISTORY_OK\\n'; else printf 'ATS_HISTORY_FAIL\\n'; fi"
